arguments.text: #1 is fixed: Interval.fromISO now catches the InvalidDateTimeError/InvalidDurationError thrown by DateTime.fromISO/Duration.fromISO when Settings.throwOnInvalid is true and returns an invalid Interval instead, so the throwOnInvalid test passes. All 127 pre-existing interval tests still pass.
#4 (src/impl/util.js, DateTime#plus across the 100 barrier) is still being diagnosed; estimate ~12 min.

parseDigits returns NaN when the input contains no parseable digits: parseInt(str, 10) is NaN, so it falls into the digit-by-digit loop, which appends nothing for unparseable characters, and the final parseInt("", 10) is NaN. (For example parseDigits("hello") === NaN.)
match returns [matches, {}] when the input does not match the regex — i.e. the first element is null (the result of String#match) and the second is an empty object.
